def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    noise=min(set(v for r in g for v in r)) if True else None
    # noise = the sparse color; bg = dominant
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    noise=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(1,w-1):
            if g[i][j]==bg and g[i][j-1]==noise and g[i][j+1]==noise:
                out[i][j]=2
    return out
# verify on both demos
